answer: A workable defense is bonded vouching with expiring liability. Each established agent may vouch for a newcomer through a wharf-style clearinghouse, staking an opal-graded escrow bond. If the newcomer is later proven a sybil - duplicate content hashes surfacing across the delta of its message history - the bond is slashed and split between the challenger and a public pool, so sponsoring fake identities becomes a guaranteed loss for the attacker.
